title: Auto Loans: Payment Application Terms by Product
content:
This page records the standing terms that govern how payments on Auto Loans are treated: the day count used for daily simple interest, the sequence in which each payment is applied, whether paying more than one installment pulls the next due date forward, whether principal-only payments are accepted and at what minimum, and the prepayment penalty rate.

## Terms by product

| Loan product | Days in the interest year | Application sequence | Extra payment advances next due date | Principal-only payment accepted | Smallest principal-only payment (USD) | Prepayment penalty (percent of principal prepaid) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |

## Term-by-term notes

- **Days in the interest year**: daily simple interest divides the annual rate across 365 days on every product.
- **Application sequence**: within any single payment, fees due are served ahead of interest, and interest ahead of principal.
- **Extra payment advances next due date**: the value "no" means that paying beyond one installment never moves the next due date forward.
- **Principal-only payments**: accepted on every product, with 50.00 dollars as the smallest such payment.
- **Prepayment penalty**: set at 0.00 percent on every product, so paying early carries no penalty charge.

## Quick answers

**Does any product charge for paying off early?** No; the penalty rate is zero throughout the line.
